top_signals.title: Stocks and Treasuries Get a Lift as Oil Retreats: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks rose alongside Treasuries as oil prices fell, raising hopes that inflation can be kept under control after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signaled more tightening to come.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. allies fret over how Trump might play his Taiwan hand with Xi
top_signals.summary: Even a subtle change in U.S. rhetoric about Taiwan could embolden Beijing and risk the region's fragile peace.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
